key: Tell me what you know about battling and I'll tell you what I know about this place!
en: Tell me what you know about battling and I'll tell you what I know about this place!
ja: バトルについて　知ってることを　教えてくれたら　こっちも　この場所について　知ってることを　教えよう!
ほほう! みごとなものだ!

key: This place is, in effect, the foot of Charous Mountain. And of course, Charous Mountain is most famous for being home to the Hall of Champions... In other words, we're right in the shadow of greatness!
en: This place is, in effect, the foot of Charous Mountain. And of course, Charous Mountain is most famous for being home to the Hall of Champions... In other words, we're right in the shadow of greatness!
ja: ここは　言ってみれば　シャルース山の　ふもとだ。そしてシャルース山と　いえば　チャンピオンの間が　あることで　有名だな……つまり　わたしたちは　偉大なるものの　すぐ足元に　いるわけだ!

key: The way down this mountain is nearby but I just can't seem to find it...
en: The way down this mountain is nearby but I just can't seem to find it...
ja: この山を　下りる道は　すぐ近くの　はずなんだが　どうにも　見つからなくてな……

key: Oh! Can you help me find it?
en: Oh! Can you help me find it?
ja: おお! 一緒に　探して　くれないか?

key: I know it's around here somewhere...
en: I know it's around here somewhere...
ja: この辺りに　あるはずなんだが……
